final: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(CAST(rental_rate AS REAL) / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS average_rate_per_day, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film WHERE rental_duration > 5 GROUP BY rating), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(average_rate_per_day) AS value FROM rating_averages) SELECT r.rating, r.average_rate_per_day, r.film_count, r.average_rate_per_day / b.value AS relative_to_benchmark FROM rating_averages AS r CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE b.value IS NOT NULL
